ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering the Extent of Daycare Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the scope of daycare fraud in Minnesota, including the number of individuals and organizations involved, the amount of money lost to fraud, and the impact on the state's childcare system.
questions: How widespread is daycare fraud in Minnesota?
What are the consequences for those involved?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose a large-scale fraud scheme and hold those responsible accountable. I recommend starting with a review of public records and financial transactions to identify suspicious patterns.
